title: Sign-ins survive resets
summary: A reset never rolls a sign-in back to the golden's older copy. macOS keeps harness logins, browser identities and Safari's cookie store live, and quits Safari before clearing. Linux and WSL verify each live Claude, Codex and Cursor login with its sealed real-request probe before clearing and carry verified ones forward. A failing login restores from the golden only if it is unchanged since the seal; otherwise reset refuses test_machine_sign_in_newer_than_baseline before clearing. Save a completed sign-in at once with golden-capture.
